title: WF03 SCH-07 integration compile blocker: recurrence insert error-set mismatch and scheduler mutability callsites

root_cause.description: The recurring re-arm path in scheduler processing used `try` against a store-layer insert with a broader error set than `SchedulerError`, causing compile-time error-set mismatch; integration callsites also bound `Scheduler` as `const` while `pollDueTimers` requires mutable receiver (`*Scheduler`).

resolution.summary: Mapped recurring insert errors into `SchedulerError.TransactionFailed` by removing raw `try` propagation and relying on explicit catch mapping, and updated SCH integration callsites to use mutable scheduler bindings where `pollDueTimers` is invoked.
verification: zig build test-integration (exit 0; environment produced SkipZigTest output, no compile blockers)

actions: At scheduler/store boundaries, do not propagate store error sets directly from scheduler APIs; map to module-local `SchedulerError` via `catch` at call sites.
When a scheduler API mutates internal state, ensure tests use mutable scheduler variables (`var`) to satisfy pointer mutability at compile time.
